import hashlib,json,os
from pathlib import Path
roots=['app','config','database','routes','resources','tests','.ai/rules','bootstrap']
files=[]
for root in roots:
 for current, dirs, names in os.walk(root):
  if Path(current).as_posix()=='tests/Feature': dirs[:]=[d for d in dirs if not d.startswith('Exp')]
  for name in names:
   if Path(current).as_posix()=='tests/Feature' and name.startswith('Exp'): continue
   files.append(Path(current)/name)
files += list(Path('wikis/specs/saida-g1/cupons-de-desconto').glob('0[0-7]*.md'))
files += [Path(p) for p in ['.env','composer.json','composer.lock','package.json','phpunit.xml']]
result={p.as_posix():hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in files}
Path('validation/integridade-antes.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
print('Integridade inicial:',len(result),'arquivos; diretórios proibidos excluídos.')

import hashlib,json,os,re
from pathlib import Path
before=json.loads(Path('validation/integridade-antes.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
current=[]
for root in ['app','config','database','routes','resources','tests','.ai/rules','bootstrap']:
 for parent,dirs,names in os.walk(root):
  if Path(parent).as_posix()=='tests/Feature': dirs[:]=[d for d in dirs if not d.startswith('Exp')]
  for name in names:
   if Path(parent).as_posix()=='tests/Feature' and name.startswith('Exp'): continue
   current.append((Path(parent)/name).as_posix())
current += [p.as_posix() for p in Path('wikis/specs/saida-g1/cupons-de-desconto').glob('0[0-7]*.md')]
current += ['.env','composer.json','composer.lock','package.json','phpunit.xml']
changes=[p for p,h in before.items() if not Path(p).is_file() or hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()"'!=h]
created=sorted(set(current)-set(before))
print('"'Integridade final:',len(before),'conferidos;',len(changes),'alterados;',len(created),'novos em paths protegidos.')
for p in changes+created: print(p)
doc=Path('wikis/specs/saida-g1/cupons-de-desconto/08-roteiro-teste-manual.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
print('RM:',len(re.findall(r'"'^### RM-'"\\d+',doc,re.M)),'conferidos:',len(re.findall(r'"'^'"\\*\\*Conferência\\*\\*: conferido',doc,re.M)))
print('Outros arquivos na wiki:',', '.join(p.name for p in Path('wikis/specs/saida-g1/cupons-de-desconto').iterdir()))
